page.layout: One printed title page: title block centred at top, a woodcut vignette in the middle, imprint and date centred below. No margins with text.

main_text.l: loco Scoto, Ministro Iesu Christi, & Re-

page.notes: Woodcut vignette between the title and the imprint: a Hebrew tetragrammaton (יהוה) in a cloud above a tree, with two figures seated and standing beside it. The Hebrew word is printed in Hebrew letters and is not transcribed as Latin. The imprint line "Apud Iacobum Stoer," is partly worn; "Stoer" is read as printed "Sroer". The date reads MDCX as printed, with the X partly worn.
